entries.title: Isaiah 41:1
segments: Keep silence before Me, O coasts; and peoples shall renew strength; let them come near; then let them speak; let us come near together for judgment.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:2
segments: Who raised up the righteous one from the east, called him to His foot, gave the nations before him, and made [him] rule over kings? He gave them as the dust [to] his sword, [and] as driven stubble [to] his bow.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:3
segments: He pursued them; he passed on in peace. He does not go [by] the way of his feet.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:4
segments: Who has planned and done [it], calling forth the generations from the beginning? I the LORD [am] the first and the last; I [am] He.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:5
segments: The coastlands saw and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, and drew near, and came.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:6
segments: They each one helped his neighbor, and said to his brother, Be strong.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:7
segments: So the artisan strengthens the refiner, and he smoothing [with] the hammer, him who struck the anvil, saying of soldering, It [is] good. And he made it strong with nails; it will not totter.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:8
segments: But you, Israel, [are] My servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham, My friend;

entries.title: Isaiah 41:9
segments: whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called you from its sides. And I said to you, You [are] My servant; I have chosen you, and not cast you away.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:10
segments: Do not fear; for I [am] with you; be not dismayed; for I [am] your God. I will make you strong; yes, I will help you; yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of My righteousness.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:11
segments: Behold, all those who were angered against you shall be ashamed and confounded; they shall be as nothing. And those who fight with you shall perish.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:12
segments: You shall seek them, and shall not find them; men warring against you shall be as nothing, and as ceasing.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:13
segments: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, Do not fear; I will help you.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:14
segments: Do not fear, worm of Jacob [and] men of Israel; I will help you, says the LORD, and your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:15
segments: Behold, I make you a new sharp threshing instrument, a master of teeth; you shall thresh the mountains, and beat [them] small, and shall make the hills like chaff.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:16
segments: You shall winnow them, and the wind shall carry them away, and a tempest shall scatter them. And you shall rejoice in the LORD [and] shall glory in the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:17
segments: The poor and needy seek water, and [there is] none; their tongue fails for thirst, I the LORD will hear them, I the God of Israel will not leave them.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:18
segments: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys; I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:19
segments: I will plant the cedar in the wilderness, the acacia tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree. I will set the fir tree in the desert, [and] the pine, and the box tree together;

entries.title: Isaiah 41:20
segments: so that they may see, and know, and look on, and understand together, that the hand of the LORD has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:21
segments: Bring near your cause, says the LORD; bring out your strong [reasons], says the King of Jacob.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:22
segments: Let them bring [them] out, and tell us what shall happen; let them reveal the former things, what they [are], that we may look on them and know the final end of them; or declare to us things to come.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:23
segments: Reveal the near things after this, so that we may know that you [are] gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, so that we may be amazed and see together.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:24
segments: Behold, you [are] of nothing, and your work of nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:25
segments: I have raised up [one] from the north, and he shall come from the sunrise; he will call on My name. And he shall come [on] rulers as [on] mortar, and as the potter tramples clay.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:26
segments: Who has declared from the beginning, that we may know? And beforetime, that we may say, [He is] righteous? Yea, no one declares; yea, no one proclaims; yea, no one hears your words.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:27
segments: I first [shall say] to Zion, Behold! Behold them! and I will give to Jerusalem one who bears good news.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:28
segments: For I looked, and [there was] no man; and of these no counselor was, that I might ask and they could answer.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:29
segments: Behold, they [are] all evil; their works [are] nothing; their images [are] wind and vanity.
